evidence.title: Pentagon, under Hegseth, expands war on drug cartels with troops on ground in South America

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Special Operations Command training and rules-of-engagement records
occurrences.quote_span: Going forward, the U.S. special operations forces will help train partner forces to aid in “command and control” operations on the ground, but they “are not on target until the target’s clear,” the senior official said.

occurrences.subject: U.S. Southern Command Offensive Campaign Plan

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Southern Command Offensive Campaign Plan
occurrences.quote_span: “Based on our assessment of what needs to be done, this plan focuses on five core lines of effort: dismantling illicit networks, attacking network logistics, preventing adversary regeneration, bolstering partner sovereignty and security, and building a strong coalition,” U.S. Southern Command (Southcom) Commander Gen. Francis L. Donovan said in a recent interview with The Hill when discussing Southcom’s “Offensive Campaign Plan” that addresses regional threats to security and stability.
occurrences.speaker: Francis L. Donovan
occurrences.subject: U.S. Southern Command Offensive Campaign Plan
